about: One saved draft per place a response module outside the tool registry threw on the build before checkedQuestionDraft.js (fa22bb2b): the module scene (fixtures/toolDraftScenes.mjs RESPONSE_MODULE_SCENES), the draft key suffix or the secure payload, the damage, what threw and where, and the fix that keeps it from throwing. Found by mounting every scene on hostile values and on damaged copies of its valid drafts, then typing into the first box, pressing the first button, pressing Undo and submitting. Drafts over 4,000 characters of JSON are left out; their places are covered by shorter damage. Synthetic data.
